notes_for_editor: The record rests on one OpenStreetMap node (5618779463, 40.8416179, -81.2687448) with name=Fire Tower, man_made=tower, tower:type=observation. No Ohio lookout list we hold has an entry within about 0.1 degree of this point; the county list we checked has no Stark County row at all, but the county of this point was not established. Checked 2026-10-09 against every row of the full Ohio list (main and relocated/replica tables): no entry lies within 0.1 degree; the nearest is Carroll Leavittsville (40.51165, -81.19334), about 0.3 degree away. The 'standing' status in the record comes only from the OSM node's existence. A web search turned up a Louisville, Ohio fire station but nothing linking it to this point (unverified). It may be a fire-department training tower rather than a lookout. Suggest a human check with Ohio DNR or a local historical society before the record is kept as a lookout.
